title: sgmo-20220328
主要内容: On March 28, 2022, Saira Ramasastry, a member of the Board of Directors of Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. since June 2012, notified the Company of her decision not to stand for re-election at the Company’s annual meeting of stockholders to be held on May 24, 2022. Ms. Ramasastry is currently the longest tenured member of the Board, and has informed the Board that her decision not to stand for re-election is not due to any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company’s operations, policies or practices.
